in_arabic.name: أورخان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من اصل تركي يعني قائد و رائد

in_urdu.name: اورخان
in_urdu.long_meaning: اورخان نام کا مطلب ہے قیادت کرنے والا، رہنما، قائد۔ یہ نام ترک اصل کا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی قیادت کی صلاحیتوں کے لیے جانی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: ओरखान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ओरखान नाम का अर्थ है नेतृत्व करने वाला, मार्गदर्शक। यह नाम तुर्की मूल का है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसका विशेष महत्व है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो अपनी नेतृत्व क्षमता के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: اورخان
in_pashto.long_meaning: اورخان نوم د مشرانو، د رهبرۍ کوونکی معنی لري. دا نوم د ترک اصلي دی او په اسلامي کلتور کې یې مهم ځای لري. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره غوره کیږي چې د خپلې رهبرۍ وړتیا لپاره پېژندل شوي دي.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Orkhan" carries a strong sense of authority and leadership, stemming from its Turkish roots meaning "man of the mountain." Historically, mountainous regions have long been associated with power and sovereignty, as they offered natural defenses and resources. Orkhan could be an apt name for a leader who is strong, resilient, and wise, just like the unyielding mountains.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Orkhan evokes images of being a guiding light, a stable foundation, and a protector. Mountains have long been considered sacred places in many spiritual and religious traditions, serving as symbols of the divine. As the "man of the mountain," Orkhan can be seen as a conduit for spiritual wisdom, providing guidance and support to those seeking enlightenment and stability in their lives.

historical_references.reference: Orkhan I, also known as Orkhan the Conqueror, was a Mongol ruler of the Ilkhanate in Persia from 1304 to 1316. He extended the Ilkhanate's territories to include much of Iran, Anatolia, and Iraq.
historical_references.context: Mongol ruler of the Ilkhanate in Persia

historical_references.reference: Orkhan II, also known as Orkhan Gazi, was the founder of the Ottoman Empire in 1299 and ruled as the Sultan from 1326 to 1362. He was the first sultan of the Ottoman Empire and established the Ottoman dynasty.
historical_references.context: Founder of the Ottoman Empire and first sultan
